spans.s: dám, house (only ˚— and g. pl. damā́m).
1. dám-a, m. n. house, abode, home.
dama-ka, a. taming, breaking in, training 🞄(—˚).
dama-ghoṣa, m. N. of a king: -ja, 🞄-suta, m. pt. of Śiśupāla.
damana-ka, m. N. of a man and of 🞄a jackal.
dam-ay-ant-ī, f. (cs. pr. pt.) Victoria, 🞄N. of a Nalaʼs wife.
dam-ay-i-tṛ, m. tamer, chastiser.

dam-in, a. self-controlled;
 subduing 🞄(—˚).
dambha-muni, m. hypocritical ascetic.

dambh-in, a. deceitful;
 m. deceiver, 🞄cheat, hypocrite, dishonest man.
dambha‿udbhava, m. N. of a king.
dambholi m. Indraʼs thunderbolt: 🞄-pāta, m. descent of Indraʼs thunderbolt.
dambholi-pātā-ya, den. Ā. 🞄descend like Indraʼs thunderbolt.

dam-ya, fp. to be broken in;
 m. young 🞄bull yet to be tamed or trained.
dāma-lipta, n., ā, f. N. of a town.
dāmodarī-ya, a. belonging to 🞄(king) Dāmodara.

dāmbh-ika, a. deceitful, hypocritical, 🞄fraudulent;
 m. cheat, hypocrite.
